source: docs/copenhagen-d1/published-network.json (Wikipedia Copenhagen Metro station list + station infoboxes, hand-transcribed and cross-validated). Not generated from GTFS. Copenhagen is a config over the shared Rejseplanen national platform per docs/denmark-ledger.md — not city=denmark, not merged with any future Aarhus pack.
notes: v1: Metro M1-M4 (44 stations, full network) PLUS S-tog (A, B, Bx, C, E, H, F) PLUS DSB Regional/InterCity/InterCityLyn PLUS Öresundståg, the latter three scoped ONLY to the four shared stations (Nørreport, Nørrebro, København H, Nordhavn) named in the oracle report's board-eligibility table - not the full S-tog/DSB network.

Direction model: Metro linear lines (M1, M2, M4) use line + terminus. M3 is a true ring (Cityringen) - direction is clockwise/counter-clockwise, never a fake terminus pair. S-tog uses line letter + official terminus, scoped to the shared stations only. DSB Regional/InterCity/InterCityLyn/Öresundståg have no printed line code - direction is service type + destination. See docs/copenhagen-d1/direction-model-memo.md.
Kongens Nytorv is the locked Metro-only hub (all four lines, confirmed zero rail/S-tog transfer) - never a direction token.

DSB EuroCity (out-reservation, compulsory 26 Jun-16 Aug), SJ X2000 (out-reservation, unverdicted for board-eligibility per hazard-pack.md H3 - not decided either way), České dráhy ComfortJet (out-reservation, unverdicted), and harbour buses (out-mode) are excluded from every board.

stog-a.note: Daytime trains mostly short-turn Hundige (every 2nd extended Solrød Strand); evening trains run through to Køge. Fixed chip pair per D1/D5, per-trip overlay deferred to D2+ (direction-model-memo.md open question 2).

lines.note: Ring Line - the only S-tog service at Nørrebro. Does not call at Nørreport, København H, or Nordhavn.

lines.name: Regionaltog
lines.note: No printed line code - direction is 'Regionaltog + <destination>'. Destinations indicative, not exhaustive (Valby, København S, Høje Taastrup, Ringsted).

lines.name: InterCity
lines.note: No printed line code - direction is 'InterCity + <destination>' or 'InterCityLyn + <destination>'. Destinations indicative: Valby, København S, Ringsted (IC); Copenhagen Airport, Odense (ICL).

lines.name: Öresundståg
lines.note: No printed line code - direction is 'Öresundståg + <destination>' using the printed corridor name (Lund, Gothenburg, Kalmar, Karlskrona). Nørreport inclusion flagged for Tim confirmation (direction-model-memo.md open question 4).
